Dear Michelle,

Thank you for your prompt response and for clarifying that the South Wales Central Medical Examiner Service does not hold records dating back to these deaths.

I appreciate your advice regarding the registrars' offices. I will follow that route.

For completeness, could you please clarify whether, in addition to the registration records, you would expect any historical records relating to these deaths — for example, medical certificates of cause of death, coroner's referrals or inquest records, or archived hospital records — to be held by another NHS body, the coroner's service, or an archive rather than the registrars?

In particular, I am trying to establish the documentary trail surrounding:

  *   William (Billy) Buckler, who died at Llandough Hospital on or about 29 May 1990; and
  *   Mary Doreen Williams, whose death was registered in March 1983 in South Glamorgan (Vol. 28, p. 3029).

I understand that the Medical Examiner Service itself did not exist at the time, so I am simply trying to identify the correct historical custodian of any surviving records.

Thank you again for pointing me in the right direction.

Kind regards,


Sion Buckler Ret'd Sergeant

Royal Signals Cyber and Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member

On Fri, 21 Aug 2026, 03:55 SouthWalesCentral MedicalExaminersOffice (Gen126594),  > wrote:
Good morning

Thank you for your email

Unfortunately, we do not hold ay records dating back this far and Data Protection would not allow us to release these either if they were held.

You would therefore need to contact the registrars office in Cardiff and the Vale of Glamorgan who may be able to assist you further.

Kind regards

Michelle


Micehlle Burnett

Dear Medical Examiner Service (South Wales Central),

I am writing to enquire whether any records or references are held in relation to the following historical deaths that occurred in the Cardiff & Vale / Llandough area:

1. William (Billy) Buckler
   - Died at Llandough Hospital on or about 29 May 1990, aged 41
   - Reported cause: heart attack

2. Mary Doreen Williams
   - Born 10 August 1913
   - Death registered March 1983, South Glamorgan (Vol 28, Page 3029)

Although these pre-date the current Medical Examiner Service, I would be grateful if you could advise whether any legacy records, referrals, or related documentation exist, or direct me to the appropriate archive or department that may hold such information.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber and Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
